excerpts.content:
i think
1) we should move away from the create transaction where possible (not AA friendly)
2) does not require special handling, it’s simply a serialization rule (e.g. the address must always be present, so the tx always has a target)
3) avoids the union type which isn’t widely supported yet and tends to complicate things from HTRs to zk circuits
